fields.description: Issue features local political and civic reporting in Miami, including coverage of efforts to appoint John Rowland as chief of police and discussion of "Little Tammany" influence. Reports on City Clerk Harold E. Ross and a city-funds shortage, including claims about the status of his surety bond and calls for grand jury action, with references to former Mayor Ev Sewell and City Solicitor Abe Aronovitz. Includes consumer warnings about loan sharks and salary buyers, commentary on telephone company practices and rates, and extensive sports/racing content (including "Jockey Jimmy" racing information). Also contains community columns (e.g., "They Tell Me"), a welcome notice to Safety Director Andrew J. Kavanaugh, and ongoing promotional coverage of Miami Life's "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest (Miss Louise Wolfe named as a weekly winner).
